specs.title: UI-002: Add a product with quantity 2 to the cart

steps.title: Create a product for this test through the API: a unique name, in stock.
Set the quantity to 2 and click "Add to cart".
Verify the cart badge in the nav bar shows 2.
Open the cart.
Verify the cart has exactly one line: that product with quantity 2.
Verify the cart total equals 2 × the product's unit price.

specs.title: UI-027: Adding a product to the cart shows a success message

steps.title: Click "Add to cart".
Verify the message "Product added to shopping cart." is shown.

specs.title: UI-013: The product page shows the product's information and related products

steps.title: Verify the product image is shown.
Verify the name "Combination Pliers" is shown.
Verify the product description is shown.
Verify the price "$14.15" is shown.
Verify the category badge "Pliers" is shown.
Verify the brand badge "ForgeFlex Tools" is shown.
Verify the "Related products" section is shown below the product information.
Verify the "Related products" section shows at least one product.

specs.title: UI-014: A discounted product shows the original price struck through, the discounted price and the discount badge

steps.title: Verify the original price is shown struck through.
Verify the discounted price is shown.
Verify a discount percentage badge is shown.

specs.title: UI-085: A rental that is a location offer shows the discount, the discounted hourly rate and the discounted total for a visitor in London

steps.title: Set the duration slider to 3 hours.
Verify the discount badge "-25%" is shown.
Verify the hourly rate is shown struck through.
Verify the discounted hourly rate is shown, 25% below the hourly rate.
Verify the total price equals 3 × the discounted hourly rate.

specs.title: UI-015: An out-of-stock product can't be added to the cart

steps.title: Verify "Add to cart" is disabled.
Verify "Out of stock" is shown.
Verify "Out of stock" is shown in red.

specs.title: UI-016: A rental product shows a duration slider instead of the quantity buttons

steps.title: Verify a duration slider is shown.
Verify the duration slider goes from 1 to 10 hours.
Verify the "Increase quantity" (+) and "Decrease quantity" (-) buttons are not shown.

specs.title: UI-017: A rental's total price is the hourly rate times the duration

steps.title: Set the duration slider to 3 hours.
Verify the total price equals 3 × the hourly rate.

specs.title: UI-028: Adding a product to favourites shows a success message

steps.title: Click "Add to favourites".
Verify the message "Product added to your favorites list." is shown.

specs.title: UI-029: Adding a product that is already a favourite shows a message

steps.title: Click "Add to favourites".
Verify the message "Product already in your favorites list." is shown.

specs.title: UI-030: A logged-out visitor can't add a product to favourites

steps.title: Click "Add to favourites".
Verify the message "Unauthorized, can not add product to your favorite list." is shown.

specs.title: UI-075: Checking a category shows only that category's products

steps.title: Check the category "Pliers" in the sidebar.
Verify the grid shows only the products of the category "Pliers": the products the catalogue lists for it in the page's default price range, $1 to $100.

specs.title: UI-076: Checking a parent category checks all its child categories

steps.title: Check the category "Hand Tools" in the sidebar.
Verify the child categories "Hammer", "Hand Saw", "Wrench", "Screwdriver", "Pliers", "Chisels" and "Measures" are checked.

specs.title: UI-077: Unchecking all child categories unchecks the parent category

steps.title: Check the category "Hand Tools" in the sidebar.
Uncheck the child category "Hammer".
Uncheck the child category "Hand Saw".
Uncheck the child category "Wrench".
Uncheck the child category "Screwdriver".
Uncheck the child category "Pliers".
Uncheck the child category "Chisels".
Uncheck the child category "Measures".
Verify the category "Hand Tools" is not checked.

specs.title: UI-078: Checking a brand shows only that brand's products

steps.title: Check the brand "MightyCraft Hardware" in the sidebar.
Verify the grid shows only the products of the brand "MightyCraft Hardware": the products the catalogue lists for it in the page's default price range, $1 to $100.

specs.title: UI-079: Checking a category and a brand shows only products that match both

steps.title: Check the category "Pliers" in the sidebar.
Check the brand "ForgeFlex Tools" in the sidebar.

Verify the grid shows only the products that belong to both the category "Pliers" and the brand "ForgeFlex Tools": the products the catalogue lists for both filters in the page's default price range, $1 to $100.

specs.title: UI-080: Moving the price range slider shows only products within the new range

steps.title: Move the upper handle of the price range slider to 15.
Move the lower handle of the price range slider to 10.
Verify at least one product is shown.
Verify the price of every product shown is between $10 and $15.

specs.title: UI-012: An out-of-stock product shows "Out of stock" on its card

steps.title: Verify the card of "Long Nose Pliers" shows "Out of stock".

specs.title: UI-070: The home page shows a grid of product cards with an image, a name and a price

steps.title: Verify the product grid shows at least one product card.
Verify every card shows a product image.
Verify every card shows a product name.
Verify every card shows a price.

specs.title: UI-071: Clicking a product card opens that product's page

steps.title: Click the card of "Combination Pliers".
Verify the product detail page is shown.
Verify the name "Combination Pliers" is shown.

specs.title: UI-072: The pagination controls are shown below the grid and page 2 shows other products

steps.title: Verify the pagination controls are shown below the product grid.
Click page "2" in the pagination.
Verify at least one product is shown.
Verify none of the products shown was shown on page 1.
Verify page "2" is marked as the active page.

specs.title: UI-073: The price range slider is shown with the range $1 to $100 and a maximum of $200

steps.title: Verify the price range slider is shown in the sidebar.
Verify the lower handle is at 1.
Verify the upper handle is at 100.
Verify the maximum of the slider is 200.

specs.title: UI-074: A location offer's card shows the original price struck through and the discounted price for a visitor in London

steps.title: Verify the card of "Bolt Cutters" is shown on the first page.
Verify the card of "Bolt Cutters" shows its original price struck through.
Verify the card of "Bolt Cutters" shows the discounted price, 25% below the original price.

specs.title: UI-018: An in-stock product shows the quantity selector set to 1

steps.title: Verify the quantity field is shown.
Verify the "Increase quantity" (+) button is shown.
Verify the "Decrease quantity" (-) button is shown.
Verify the quantity is 1.

specs.title: UI-019: The plus button increases the quantity by 1

steps.title: Click "Increase quantity".
Verify the quantity is 2.

specs.title: UI-020: The minus button decreases the quantity by 1

steps.title: Click "Increase quantity".
Click "Increase quantity".
Verify the quantity is 3.
Click "Decrease quantity".
Verify the quantity is 2.

specs.title: UI-021: The minus button keeps the quantity at 1

steps.title: Verify the quantity is 1.
Click "Decrease quantity".
Verify the quantity is still 1.

specs.title: UI-022: A quantity typed into the field is used

steps.title: Enter 5 in the quantity field.
Verify the quantity is 5.
Click "Increase quantity".
Verify the quantity is 6.

specs.title: UI-023: A typed quantity of 0 is set to 1

steps.title: Enter 0 in the quantity field.
Verify the quantity is 1.

specs.title: UI-026: A typed quantity of 1 is accepted

steps.title: Click "Increase quantity".
Enter 1 in the quantity field.
Verify the quantity is 1.
Click "Increase quantity".
Verify the quantity is 2.

specs.title: UI-001: Search by name shows only matching products

steps.title: Search for "pliers".
Verify the caption reads "Searched for: pliers".
Verify at least one product is shown.
Verify every product name contains "pliers" (case-insensitive).

specs.title: UI-003: Search resets the active category and brand filters

steps.title: Check the category "Hammer" in the sidebar.
Check the brand "ForgeFlex Tools" in the sidebar.
Search for "pliers".
Verify the category "Hammer" is not checked.
Verify the brand "ForgeFlex Tools" is not checked.
Verify at least one product is shown.
Verify every product name contains "pliers" (case-insensitive).

specs.title: UI-004: Search with a 3-character term is accepted

steps.title: Search for "ham".
Verify the caption reads "Searched for: ham".
Verify at least one product is shown.
Verify every product name contains "ham" (case-insensitive).

specs.title: UI-005: Search with a 40-character term is accepted

steps.title: Search for a term of exactly 40 characters.
Verify the caption reads "Searched for: " followed by the term.

specs.title: UI-006: Search with a 2-character term is rejected

steps.title: Search for "pl".
Verify no "Searched for:" caption is shown.
Verify the product grid still shows the first page of all products.

specs.title: UI-007: Search with a 41-character term is rejected

steps.title: Search for a term of exactly 41 characters.
Verify no "Searched for:" caption is shown.
Verify the product grid still shows the first page of all products.

specs.title: UI-008: Sort by name from A to Z

steps.title: Select "Name (A - Z)" in the sort list.
Verify the product names are in alphabetical order, A to Z.

specs.title: UI-009: Sort by name from Z to A

steps.title: Select "Name (Z - A)" in the sort list.
Verify the product names are in reverse alphabetical order, Z to A.

specs.title: UI-010: Sort by price from high to low

steps.title: Select "Price (High - Low)" in the sort list.
Verify the products are sorted by price, highest first.

specs.title: UI-011: Sort by price from low to high

steps.title: Select "Price (Low - High)" in the sort list.
Verify the products are sorted by price, lowest first.

specs.title: UI-082: Each rental card shows an image, a name and a description

steps.title: Verify the page shows at least one rental card.
Verify every rental card shows a product image.
Verify every rental card shows its name.
Verify every rental card shows a description that is not empty.

specs.title: UI-083: Clicking a rental card opens its product page with the duration slider

steps.title: Click the card of "Excavator".
Verify the product page of "Excavator" is shown, with the name "Excavator".
Verify a duration slider is shown.

specs.title: UI-081: The Rentals page opens from the Categories menu and lists the rental products

steps.title: Open the "Categories" menu.
Click "Rentals".
Verify the "Rentals" page is shown, with the heading "Rentals".
Verify the cards of "Excavator", "Bulldozer" and "Crane" are shown.
